label: For "Automated Valuation Model (AVM)": Estimate the market value of a home from its attributes, location, nearby sales and photos, with a confidence range, for lenders, portals and owners. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on sales after the valuation date leaks the trend.
